label: Infinitist noncircularity and…: In the authors’ enhancement account a reason may not merely repeat…
definition: In the authors’ enhancement account a reason may not merely repeat the target content (including a conjunction containing it), and a reason is not sufficiently justified independently of a further reason. The latter is motivated by continued legitimate challenge. These are presented as necessary but not jointly sufficient conditions for enhancing a target. Whether every terminal noninferential warrant is therefore arbitrary is a disputed normative premise, not a graph definition.
note: Source-specific epistemic reading, not an interpretation of physical causation, existence or GeneratedWarrant. No universal adequacy standard is established by attribution.
